name: agent-ready
description: Sets up a codebase for coding agents, or measures an existing one and cleans it up step by step.

comment_review.title: Comment review
comment_review.description: Block git push and gh pr create until comment-review has checked the comments on the branch.

steering_gate.title: Steering gate
steering_gate.description: Write CODEOWNERS and the ruleset bootstrap so a human must approve every change to a steering file, and block gh pr merge on a steering diff. The ruleset blocks only on a Team or public repo.

cleanup_comments.title: Cleanup comments
cleanup_comments.description: During a refactor phase, give every cleaned file a full comment pass. Costly: several subagents per file.

cleanup_comments_max_files.title: Cleanup comments: files per PR
cleanup_comments_max_files.description: Most files one cleanup PR gives the comment pass. The rest stay on the path list.
